title: Tripaksheeya Sangharsh (Kannauj)
hook: Tripaksheeya Sangharsh (Kannauj): Dharmapala ne Chakrayudha ko Kannauj ka raja banaya; Nagabhata II ne use hataya.
exam_points: Dharmapala ne Chakrayudha ko Kannauj ka raja banaya; Nagabhata II ne use hataya.
Rashtrakutas (Dhruva, Govinda III) ne Pratihara aur Pala dono ko haraya.
Antatah Pratihara Mihira Bhoja ne Kannauj par pakad banayi.

mcqs.q: Tripaksheeya sangharsh kis nagar ke liye tha?
